column2: for f in "$STATE"/alerts/*.rec; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; i=${f##*/}; printf '%s\t%s\n' "${i%.rec}" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
for f in "$DATA"/jg-trunk-landing/*.state; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; i=${f##*/}; printf '%s\t%s\n' "${i%.state}" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
for f in "$STATE"/*.meta; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; i=${f##*/}; printf '%s\t%s\n' "${i%.meta}" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
for f in "$STATE"/*.inbox/*.msg; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; d=${f%/*}; d=${d##*/}; n=${f##*/}; printf '%s\t%s\n' "${d%.inbox}:${n%.msg}" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
for f in "$STATE"/trunk-tip-*; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; i=${f##*/trunk-tip-}; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$i" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
for f in "$STATE"/*.status; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; i=${f##*/}; printf '%s\t%s\n' "${i%.status}" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
for f in "$STATE"/*.meta; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; i=${f##*/}; printf "%s\t%s\n" "${i%.meta}" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done
